$comment: Tool / function declarations for the HitWatch agent. Same shape works as Gemini functionDeclarations and as ElevenLabs server-tool parameter schemas. Backend endpoints are suggestions.

tools.name: log_symptoms
tools.description: Save today's HitWatch follow-up answers for this athlete and hit.

symptoms.description: Each symptom asked about, with severity 0-6.

name.description: Symptom name from the checklist, snake_case, e.g. headache, light_sensitivity.

red_flags.description: Emergency signs reported, snake_case, e.g. repeated_vomiting, worsening_headache.

athlete_quote.description: Short paraphrase of what the athlete said.

tools.name: compare_to_baseline
tools.description: Compare today's symptoms and the athlete's wearable data (HRV, resting heart rate, sleep) to their own preseason baseline. Returns whether to escalate and why.
tools.returns: { escalate: boolean, urgency: 'routine'|'same_day'|'urgent', reasons: string[], symptom_total_today: number, symptom_total_baseline: number, wearable: { hrv_pct_vs_baseline, rhr_delta_bpm, sleep_h_avg_3d, data_available } }

tools.name: draft_alert
tools.description: Create an alert DRAFT for the coach/trainer approval queue. Never sends anything by itself; a human must approve it.

summary.description: Two sentences for the coach: what changed and why it matters. No diagnosis.

tools.name: schedule_followup
tools.description: Schedule the next HitWatch call (tomorrow by default, or a callback time the athlete asked for).

when_iso.description: ISO 8601 date-time for the next call.
